videos.script: Every defence in this course decides one request at a time. Counted over the hours, the same decisions tell you what is happening to the whole assistant. {{title}} Two days of hourly counts, with three incidents planted in the second. {{counts}} The obvious rule pages when more than two per cent of replies are refused. It woke somebody four times at night, for one refusal in one call. {{naive}} And it missed two of the three incidents, because nobody wrote a rule for them. {{missed}} Three rules, each shaped for its signal. A canary pages on the first. Refused replies open a ticket at three times their usual level, from five events up. {{tuned}} All three incidents, and nothing else. {{caught}} And one more rule, about the monitoring itself. An hour with no data is an alert, because silence looks exactly like a quiet day. {{silence}}
